Method of Attack: DDoS botnet operation with ransom demands embedded in DDoS packets
Encryption of communication with C2 server to evade detection
Renting botnet firepower to other threat actors
Impacted Systems: Systems in China, United States, Europe, Australia, Japan, Russia, Brazil, Canada
Attack Vector: Communication with 42 C2 domains controlling 60,000 active bots
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom demands embedded in 'Data' portion of DDoS packets
Monero payment address for ransom (10 XMR ~ $1,500)
Peak attack on October 11, 2022 with 1,396 targets
